entities.title: Operations cover the everyday kinds only
entities.summary: All 26 kinds are validated structurally, but operations and typed values exist only for civil values, POSIX instants, calendar and second amounts and start-end intervals.
entities.impact: Recurrences, uncertain values, sets, clocks, logical clocks and the other kinds can be checked for shape and nothing more; an operation given one answers unsupported (unsupported-operand), and fromJson gives unsupported (unsupported-operand) for any value no typed class can hold.
entities.workaround: Keep such values as UTV JSON; validateStructural still checks them.

entities.title: Proleptic Gregorian calendar only
entities.summary: Civil values in any other calendar or chronology are unsupported (unsupported-calendar).
entities.impact: A Hebrew, Julian or other calendar date can be validated structurally but not checked, compared or converted.

entities.title: Four civil forms, without location or quality
entities.summary: Only date, year-month, time and datetime forms are read; week and ordinal dates are unsupported (unsupported-form in text, unsupported-operand in JSON), and so are civil location and quality.
entities.impact: Values in other civil forms, or carrying location or quality, can't be used in operations.

entities.title: No leap-second table and no end-of-day policy
entities.summary: Second 60 is unsupported (leap-second), 24:00 is unsupported (end-of-day), and SI seconds can't be added to a POSIX instant (needs-leap-seconds).
entities.impact: 23:59:60 can be validated structurally but not built, parsed or resolved; ElapsedSeconds can be held but not applied to an Instant.

entities.title: POSIX instants only
entities.summary: Instants must be on the unix-posix timescale with ticks; another timescale, a coordinate or quality is unsupported (unsupported-operand).
entities.impact: TAI, GPS, TT and other timescales can't be compared or converted.

entities.title: Zones only from a supplied rule bundle, inside its window
entities.summary: Named zones resolve only under a rule bundle the caller passes, and only for zones and dates it covers; there is no bundled tz database.
entities.impact: A zone missing from the bundle is unsupported (unknown-zone), a date outside its window is unsupported (outside-rule-window), and zone rules embedded in a value (zone.rules) are unsupported (unsupported-operand). The only bundle in the repository is the demo bundle: New York, Paris and Reykjavik for 2026–2027.
entities.workaround: Pass a rule bundle in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json that covers the zones and years needed.

entities.title: Start-end intervals of dates or instants only
entities.summary: contains, overlaps, the typed Interval and the text form handle only start-end intervals in the civil/gregory and physical domains.
entities.impact: start-amount and amount-end intervals and other domains are unsupported (unsupported-operand) and have no text form (no-text-form). An interval marked empty works in contains and overlaps (impossible) but has no typed value and no text form.

entities.title: Calendar, clock-tick and elapsed amounts with whole components
entities.summary: Amount sequences, other bases, other clock-tick rules and fractional calendar components are unsupported.
entities.impact: P1.5M can't be parsed (unsupported-form) or added (unsupported-operand).

entities.title: Some answers are JavaScript numbers
entities.summary: Day counts, months, days, hours and the other civil fields are numbers, and a civil date-time holds whole nanoseconds.
entities.impact: daysBetween beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER days is unsupported (implementation-limit); an instant finer than a nanosecond can't become a civil date-time (implementation-limit) or be formatted (no-text-form); toPlainDate and toEpochMilliseconds refuse values beyond a safe integer (out-of-native-range).

entities.title: Values without a text form
entities.summary: Exact second counts, mixed-sign periods, zoned dates and times, offsets with seconds and EDTF qualifiers have no text form.
entities.impact: formatText answers unsupported (no-text-form) and a typed value's toString prints its JSON; PosixSeconds and ElapsedSeconds print a display string that parse does not read; 1347~ and 134X parse as unsupported (unsupported-form).

entities.title: Extensions are not interpreted
entities.summary: Structural validation checks only that extensions is an object; extension names, types and criticality are not read.
entities.impact: A value with an unknown critical extension passes structural validation instead of failing closed.

entities.title: Needs Node.js's file system module
entities.summary: zones.ts imports node:fs, so the package loads only where node:fs exists.
entities.impact: A runtime that provides no node:fs module (a browser without a bundler that supplies one) cannot load the package, even for code that never loads a rule file.
